covers: Main arc completion (incl. The recipe artefact (per the CP-10 precedent for main-repo rows) is the build's own suite: server/tests/concordia-main-arc-load.test.js (6,960 B, md5 ed1bd78f) — node --test, the authored-dialogue harness pattern (runMigrations + real seedContent over the real content tree on an in-memory DB, one boot). Its seven its: seedContent ok · arc sizes as authored (7 chapters / 29 objectives main; 4 quests / 10 objectives Sere) · every arc quest registered in _authoredQuests · every arc quest bridged into world_quests (own world, status available, authored=1) · objectives verbatim in objectives_json + quest_objectives rows at the System B mapper's exact contract (type+target) with the 39-objective total pinned · chain linkage retained exactly + resolving inside the registered corpus (main = one follow_up chain; Sere = prerequisite ladder ending at sere_arc_4_heal_the_pact, the Twin Pact payoff) · the live read path (getAvailableQuests per world) returns the arcs. Expectations derive from the authored files read at runtime — the suite pins the files as they stand. Execution state, stated exactly: the suite executes in the full-tree gate / CI; the fixer seat's audit worktree is sparse with no node_modules, so the suite was NOT run at the seat (declared at claim time, dossier 811/812). Seat-side gate evidence stands as: the executed determination census (corpus 135 quest ids = the A-01 count; main arc 7/29 with the follow_up chain fully resolving; Sere arc 4/10 with the prerequisite ladder resolving; zero broken references; both files pass the seeder's validateQuest shape — dossier NOTE 811) · the seeder/engine assertion surfaces read first-hand (seedQuestFile, seedQuestIntoSystemB, mapAuthoredObjectivesToSystemB, getAvailableQuests) · node --check clean on the landed file · blob read-back of the landing (ed1bd78f, byte-identical).
discriminator: Pre-fix discriminator, stated exactly (no replayed transcript exists for this row and none is claimed): before this build NO repo test seeded either arc through the real seedContent — the only Sere test (sere-arc.test.js) inserts player_quests rows by hand and pins payoff mechanics, never the load — so the server half of AD-06's acceptance was UNPROVEN: the content stood complete (determination at dossier NOTE 811) and the seeder's load paths existed in code (the explicit main-arc seed + the H1 per-world walk that loads content/world/sere/quests/), but a dropped, renamed, de-linked or validation-failing arc quest would have failed silently at runtime, not in any suite. The build's suite (server/tests/concordia-main-arc-load.test.js) is itself the discriminating artefact: absent on the pre-fix tree, and on the build tree its seven its pin the load end-to-end (seedContent ok · arc sizes as authored · registration + world_quests bridging · objectives at the System B contract · chain linkage · live read path). First execution rides the full-tree gate / CI, as declared in the covers; verified_against stays null until a reviewer runs the suite on a full tree and flips the recipe active.
